transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because most days I feel like I’m at the bottom of a dark hole. Even when I’m around people I know, there’s this heavy, hopeless feeling that I just can’t shake.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About a year and two months now. It started after I fell at the HVAC job and hurt my back. Things just started unraveling after that.
Along with feeling this way, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?

Yeah. I used to love hiking, painting, going to the makerspace, even figuring out a tricky install at work. Now I just look at the supplies or ignore people calling me. It doesn’t feel worth starting anything.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt the complete opposite—unusually energetic, wired, or needing much less sleep than usual?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I haven’t really noticed times where I felt unusually energetic or like I could get by without sleep.
Before this started about a year ago, had you ever experienced another period in your life where you felt depressed like this?
I don’t know. I can’t really think of another time that felt like this.
How has your sleep been since you started feeling this way?

It’s all over the place. Some nights I lie awake for hours—my back hurts and I just keep thinking about the bills. Other times I sleep half the day and still wake up feeling like I didn’t rest at all.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight over this past year?

My eating’s been all over the place. I’ll go most of the day just drinking coffee because food kind of turns my stomach, then late at night I’ll pick at whatever’s in the cabinet without really even tasting it.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking in energy almost every day?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had some days where I don’t feel like doing much, but I don’t know if it’s more than that.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or feeling like you're letting everyone down?

Yeah. I keep telling myself I’m useless because I can’t work like I used to. I go over every apprentice I feel like I let down, and every unpaid bill, and it just feels like proof I’ve ruined everything.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or feeling like you'd be better off not waking up?

Yeah... I’ve had thoughts that everybody might be better off if I just didn’t wake up. And when the pain and the money stuff gets to be too much, I’ve caught myself thinking about ending it. It scares me, though.
